description: Set a dated follow-up about an object in the user's graph — 'follow up with Jane in March'. Creates a follow-up fact carrying follow_up_at (ISO 8601, usually in the future) and an optional note, connected to the object it's about. Interim shape: there is no dated query tool yet, so to read follow-ups back ('what's due this week?'), list the user's fact objects and filter on json_data.follow_up_at yourself.

about_object_id.description: What the follow-up is about (exact object_id).

name: set_follow_up
title: Set follow-up
